description: The VSAM LOAD-MODE OPEN FAILURE of 0100-TRANFILE-OPEN :254-270, and the only case in this folder seeded with a non-empty transaction master. WHY A NON-EMPTY MASTER IS AN OPEN FAILURE AND NOT A DUPLICATE-KEY FAILURE. :34-38 declares TRANSACT-FILE ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM, RECORD KEY IS FD-TRANS-ID, FILE STATUS IS TRANFILE-STATUS, and :256 opens it OPEN OUTPUT. An OPEN OUTPUT of an indexed file is VSAM LOAD MODE, not an append and not an I-O open, and load mode has a precondition the other opens do not: THE BASE CLUSTER MUST BE EMPTY. app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl:28-29 binds TRANFILE to AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS with DISP=SHR - the existing master, not a new generation - and app/catlg/LISTCAT.txt:3593-3597 records that cluster with SHROPTNS(2,3) RECOVERY UNIQUE ERASE INDEXED NOWRITECHK UNORDERED NOREUSE holding REC-TOTAL 311, and with an alternate index AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.AIX associated at :3582. A NOREUSE cluster is NOT reset by the open, so load mode cannot begin against a cluster that already holds records and the open reports file status 37 - open attempted in a mode the file's attributes will not support. That is derived from the authoritative dataset attributes, not asserted: the outcome is a function of the record count the cluster holds and the REUSE attribute the catalogue records, and this case seeds one row precisely to make the count non-zero. Its nineteen siblings all seed TRANFILE empty, so all nineteen open cleanly and run to completion; only this one exercises the failing arm. THE LADDER, STATEMENT BY STATEMENT. :255 MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT establishes the assumed failure every I/O paragraph in this program starts from. :256 OPEN OUTPUT TRANSACT-FILE reports '37'. :257 tests TRANFILE-STATUS = '00' AND NOTHING ELSE, so the ELSE at :259 takes :260 MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT rather than :258 MOVE 0. :262 tests 88 APPL-AOK, declared VALUE 0 at :143 over APPL-RESULT PIC S9(9) COMP at :142; APPL-RESULT holds 12, so the condition is FALSE, :263 CONTINUE is skipped and the ELSE at :264 runs its four statements in order: :265 DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING TRANSACTION FILE', :266 MOVE TRANFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS, :267 PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, :268 PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM. WHERE IN THE PROGRAM THIS HAPPENS, WHICH IS THE WHOLE POINT. The PROCEDURE DIVISION performs its six opens in a fixed order at :195-200: 0000-DALYTRAN-OPEN, 0100-TRANFILE-OPEN, 0200-XREFFILE-OPEN, 0300-DALYREJS-OPEN, 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN, 0500-TCATBALF-OPEN. This is the SECOND of the six, so the abend happens before the cross-reference, reject, account and category-balance files are opened at all and long before the PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' loop at :202-219 reads its first record. NOT ONE DALYTRAN RECORD IS READ. 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN never runs, 2000-POST-TRANSACTION never runs, and so 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL, 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC and 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE never run either. THE STATUS LINE, CHARACTER BY CHARACTER. IO-STATUS is a group of two PIC X items, IO-STAT1 and IO-STAT2 at :132-133, and IO-STATUS-04 at :138-140 is IO-STATUS-0401 PIC 9 followed by IO-STATUS-0403 PIC 999 - so the rendered image is exactly FOUR characters wide and can never be more. 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS :714-727 has two arms and '37' takes the second. :715 IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC is false, because both characters are digits; :716 OR IO-STAT1 = '9' is false, because IO-STAT1 is '3'; so the ELSE at :722 runs :723 MOVE '0000' TO IO-STATUS-04 and :724 MOVE IO-STATUS TO IO-STATUS-04(3:2), overlaying the two status characters onto positions three and four of the four-character image and leaving positions one and two as the zeros just moved, giving 0037. :725 DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04 concatenates the twenty-character literal and the four-character field with NOTHING between them, so the line is FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0037 - positions 1-20 the literal, 21-24 the image, and no space at the join. The trailing NNNN belongs to the COBOL literal and is not a placeholder awaiting substitution. case17 reaches the OTHER arm, :717-721, with a permanent-error status and renders NNNN9000; the two cases together drive both arms of the one paragraph. THE ABEND. 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM :707-711 displays 'ABENDING PROGRAM' at :708, moves 0 to TIMING at :709 and 999 to ABCODE at :710 - both PIC S9(9) BINARY at :147-148 - and calls CEE3ABD at :711. APPL-RESULT is 12 at that moment and the call does not return. WHAT EVERY DATASET HOLDS AFTERWARDS: EXACTLY WHAT IT WAS SEEDED WITH, AND THAT IS THE ASSERTION. Because the abend precedes the loop, nothing is read and nothing is written. ACCTFILE row 0 still carries acctdata.txt row 6's own values - ACCT-CURR-BAL 193.00 as 00000001930{, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT 0.00 as 00000000000{ and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT 0.00 as 00000000000{ - rather than the 697.77 and 504.77 a completed post would have left; TCATBALF row 0 still carries tcatbal.txt row 6's TRAN-CAT-BAL 0.00 as 0000000000{ rather than 504.77; and TRANFILE still holds exactly the one 350-byte CVTRA05Y row this case seeds, whose TRAN-ID is the sixteen bytes 0000000000683580 and whose TRAN-PROC-TS is 2022-07-18-22.01.02.000000, an earlier run's stamp. DALYTRAN and XREFFILE come back exactly as seeded, which the program must leave undisturbed. DALYREJS is declared at zero rows on the WRITES channel at its 430-byte width from app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl:34-36, and expectedWrites is empty as a positive statement that nothing was rejected: 0300-DALYREJS-OPEN was never even performed. DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE) at :34 names DELETE as the abnormal disposition, so an abended step leaves no reject generation behind in any case. THIS CASE IS THE DETECTOR FOR SUBSTITUTING A DIFFERENT OPEN VERB. An implementation that opened the master for INPUT, or for I-O, or that emptied it first, would report '00' here and go on to post the daily record - leaving TCATBALF at 504.77, ACCTFILE at 697.77 with cycle credit 504.77 and a second row in TRANFILE. If those numbers appear instead of the seeded ones, the diagnosis is not an arithmetic error: it is that the implementation substituted a verb whose precondition the dataset satisfies for the one the source issues, and POSTTRAN then mutated category, account and transaction data that the source cannot reach. Emptying the cluster to make load mode possible is equally wrong and is forbidden outright - it would be a bulk delete over a DISP=SHR production KSDS, which gate G44 prohibits anywhere in this module. WHAT THE ABEND PREVENTS, EXHAUSTIVELY. :268 sits in the second of six open paragraphs, so everything after it is unreached: the four remaining opens 0200-XREFFILE-OPEN :197, 0300-DALYREJS-OPEN :198, 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN :199 and 0500-TCATBALF-OPEN :200; the whole loop at :202-219; the six closes 9000-DALYTRAN-CLOSE :221 through 9500-TCATBALF-CLOSE :226; both count lines, DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :' WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT at :227 and DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :' WS-REJECT-COUNT at :228; the IF WS-REJECT-COUNT > 0 / MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE / END-IF at :229-231; DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN02C' at :232; and GOBACK at :234. The four-entry message list is therefore the assertion rather than an abbreviation of a longer one: the only line emitted before the ladder is the opening banner at :194, because 0000-DALYTRAN-OPEN succeeds silently. NO TRAN-PROC-TS IS COMPOSED EITHER, because :437-438 live inside 2000-POST-TRANSACTION, which is never performed; ParityHarness.DEFAULT_PINNED_CLOCK still fixes the instant at 2022-07-19T23:12:34 UTC (practice B7) and this case simply never reads it. THE RETURN CODE AND WHERE 12 COMES FROM. CBTRN02C executes no MOVE ... TO RETURN-CODE on any abend path; its single such statement is the literal 4 at :230, which sits downstream of END-PERFORM and is unreachable here. The value asserted is the one the abend itself carries: the translation raises common.AbendException through the job's shared failure tail, which passes the current APPL-RESULT as the RETURN-CODE - 12, AbendException.RETURN_CODE_IO_ERROR, the value :260 moved - alongside ABCODE 999 and TIMING 0 from :710 and :709. Twelve sits inside the domain this model permits, 0, 3, 4, 8, 12 and 16, and satisfies gate G35, which requires the abend to carry the code the COBOL held. Note what it displaces: on this seed a completed run rejects nothing and would have ended at 0, which is exactly what case01 - the same four inputs with TRANFILE empty - asserts. THE WIDTHS AND THE FILLER SPANS, DERIVED. CVTRA05Y declares FOURTEEN spans, not fifteen: 16 + 2 + 4 + 10 + 100 + 11 + 9 + 50 + 50 + 10 + 16 + 26 + 26 + 20 = 350, the last of them FILLER PIC X(20). CVACT01Y is 300 with FILLER PIC X(178); CVTRA01Y is 50 with FILLER PIC X(22); CVACT03Y is 50 with FILLER PIC X(14). Omitting any of them would leave a record short by exactly that span, which is why the image is pinned beside the fields. All five relations are pinned on the final-state channel, each field by field AND as a whole record image whose length proves the total width - DALYTRAN 350, XREFFILE 50, ACCTFILE 300, TCATBALF 50, TRANFILE 350 (gates G19, G21). TCATBALF's FILLER is the fixture's own twenty-two zero characters, unchanged because nothing was written to it at all. ENCODING AND NUMERIC POLICY. Every row here is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never taken from a platform default (practice B8). The overpunch convention in these fixtures is positive final digit 0-9 as { A B C D E F G H I and negative as } J K L M N O P Q R, so 0000005047G is +504.77 in an eleven-byte PIC S9(09)V99 span and 00000001930{ is 193.00 in a twelve-byte PIC S9(10)V99 span. The keyword ROUNDED appears ZERO times in this program - indeed zero times in all 28 - so every store truncates: scale exactly 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN. No arithmetic is performed by this case, which is the point; the numbers to re-derive by hand are the ones that did NOT change. The misspelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE is carried under its source name from app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy: renaming it to ACCT-EXPIRATION-DATE would leave the field-for-field diff looking for a field the decoder never produces. The cross-reference rows are still 36 bytes on disk as cardxref.txt ships them (gate G16) and the CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies CVACT03Y's trailing FILLER X(14) once, at seed time, before anything decodes the row; nothing is padded at comparison time. app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl:23 is EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C with no PARM=, so there are no job parameters. WHERE THE PER-VERB DURABILITY PROOF LIVES NOW. An earlier revision of this case asserted the duplicate-key abend of 2900 :562-579 from this same seed, and used it to prove that the 2700 and 2800 writes performed before it are not taken back. That premise cannot hold: a master holding a colliding key is a non-empty master, and a non-empty master fails at :256 before :564 is ever reached. The duplicate condition is reachable only from a collision the run itself creates - two daily records sharing a TRAN-ID over an EMPTY master - so both that path and the durability assertion moved to TransactionValidationJobTest, where a real transaction manager can prove the earlier verbs committed independently. Nothing was dropped; it was moved to where it is reachable. PROVENANCE AND STANDARDS. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl against the byte layouts of app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy, CVTRA05Y.cpy, CVACT03Y.cpy, CVACT01Y.cpy and CVTRA01Y.cpy, the DD and DCB contracts of app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl, and the catalogued cluster attributes of app/catlg/LISTCAT.txt. It is NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy program, because executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime exists, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services are present, and the IBM-supplied DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR copybooks are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the 20 cases per program, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand. Because that modifies a stated success criterion it is escalated for explicit user confirmation rather than absorbed (AAP 0.7.6, risk R-A). review_rules reports that NO USER RULES WERE PROVIDED for this project, so their absence is stated rather than filled with invented rules, and the case is held instead to the AAP 0.10.2 enterprise practices: B1 no placeholders, the seeded row a complete 350-byte record with every span populated; B3 the legacy sources and app/data are read-only and the seeded rows are byte-exact copies, the seeded master row existing only in this file; B4 the load-mode limitation derived from catalogued attributes and documented rather than papered over with a different verb; B5 the abend before any I/O preserved exactly rather than tidied into a run that does something; B7 the clock pinned rather than read; B8 explicit field-name-to-value pairs beside the record images, the code page named, the scale and rounding mode named; B11 the status image and every span width derived above so a reviewer can re-check them against the copybooks by hand; and B12 this paragraph.
